title: Pasila Library facade banner
slide_intent: Use a building surface to welcome people because identity can make a public service’s entrance more approachable and identifiable.
strategic_value: The wave division, three-language welcome and icon line can make Helsinki’s library presence visible at street scale.
demonstration: This webpage photograph shows a tall yellow-and-blue banner on Pasila Library’s brick facade, with Finnish, Swedish and English welcome text, icons and a Helsinki logo.
practical_value: Compare how type, color and imagery carry a welcome at facade scale.

content_islands.name: Library banner
content_islands.spec: Retain the complete banner, building context and credit caption.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph places the branded welcome on Pasila Library’s facade.
reference_purposes.Expression: The banner combines yellow/blue surfaces, a wave boundary, line icons and multilingual type.
